Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that the next town after Mummulgum on the Bruxner Highway was Lismore (leading them to chase “Wilsons River”). The WebSurfer result clearly stated Mummulgum is between Tenterfield and Casino, so the relevant town is Casino, which sits on the Richmond River. This wrong assumption redirected all subsequent searches to the wrong town/river.
